title: Steam Approval!
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext: Woke up this morning to a nice surprise…. My page got approved! For anyone that has launched is there any tips you could give me to prepare? I definitely will be editing my capsule. Would love some feedback on improvement!

comments.author: Bmpgames
comments.body: Thats not the hard part but congrats I guess. Just keep notes and keep checking things off like the professionals. Complete your game and levels etc and keep motivated.

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: The question was more targeted towards marketing / or other things I can do to make launch successful. I am working double time to polish my build for the demo release on Steam.

replies.author: Bmpgames
replies.body: Well if ur like me you aim for perfection and never get to promotion lol so ya wish you well and will check ur game out

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: Thanks alot and goodluck on your future development as well

comments.author: spikyness27
comments.body: It's 100USD to get to this stage right.

comments.author: Hour-Dragonfly-7499
comments.body: gonna be honest with you dawg 90%+ of players aren't gonna click on AI steam capsules

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: That’s fine w me as long as I can capture that 10% that do

replies.author: Hour-Dragonfly-7499
replies.body: why not just get a professional one done? it's been shown that professionally made steam capsules sells more units, it only costs like $300-500 but you'll get your money back and more easily from the extra sales

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: Maybe closer to launch. I’d have to see some analytics first. but that 300-500$ I would rather use for development.

replies.author: Hour-Dragonfly-7499
replies.body: steam capsule is the best investment you can make, there's tons of artists that specialize in them that you can hire

replies.author: Kypsyt
replies.body: Are you a steam capsule artist by any chance
